svg.aria-label: Two keyboards from C4 to G4. First: C4 lower voice and E4 upper voice, with the letters C, D, E numbered 1, 2, 3. Second: E4 lower voice and G4 upper voice, with E, F, G numbered 1, 2, 3. Letters only.
svg.title: Count the letters: C D E and E F G

g.text: How to read this graphic: The numbers sit on
lettered keys only. Start at the lower note
and count 1 on it, then each lettered key up
to the upper note. Both pairs end on 3 even
though the notes are different; the next step
